flows.name: 第二批夜间：保存草稿、撤销、重新打开（独立短流程）

steps.eval: (() => { const sels = ["[data-question-other=\"template_edit_confirm\"] .question-other-input","[data-question-text=\"template_edit_request\"] .question-text-input"]; let n = 0; for (const sel of sels) { for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(sel)) { if (el.value) { el.value = ''; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); n += 1; } } } return n >= 0; })()

steps.text: 生成 A 机房昨日能耗日报，报表里要有这三个板块，标题就用我写的名字：第一个板块标题「日报说明」，是说明文字；第二个板块标题「昨日总耗电」，是指标卡；第三个板块标题「设备耗电排名」，是柱状图，横轴设备名称、纵轴耗电量。

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.plan-action-select'); const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '确认方案'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.text: 把「昨日总耗电」指标卡改名为「昨日总耗电量」。

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="pending_edit_plan_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '接受修改'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
(() => { const names = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root .region-name')).map(e => e.textContent.trim()); return names.includes('昨日总耗电量'); })()

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.question-select[data-question-id="template_edit_confirm"]:not([disabled])'); if (!s || s.disabled) return false; const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '同意'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
(() => { const i = document.querySelector('dialog[open] input[name="draftName"]'); if (!i) return false; i.value = '第二批夜间保存重开验收草稿'; return true; })()
(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.wp-history-select'); if (!s) return false; s.value = 'undo'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.eval: (async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 20000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const list = document.querySelector('dialog[open] [data-draft-list]'); if (list && (list.innerText || '').includes('第二批夜间保存重开验收草稿')) return true; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } return false; })()

(async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 20000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const list = document.querySelector('dialog[open] [data-draft-list]'); if (list && (list.innerText || '').includes('第二批夜间保存重开验收草稿')) return true; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); } return false; })()

(() => { const names = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root .region-name')).map(e => e.textContent.trim()); if (!names.includes('昨日总耗电') || !names.includes('日报说明') || !names.includes('设备耗电排名')) return false; const t = document.getElementById('preview-root').innerText || ''; return t.includes('5297.2'); })()
